3.2.condition: An open V⊂U contains closure of the entire iterate sequence; inf_V f=min f; Hessian is continuous and positive definite throughoutV.

4.1.condition: For everyδ>0 there is C² convex fδ on an open convex neighborhood Uδ⊂U of the initial sublevel, agreeing with f whenever f(x0)≥f(x)≥min f+δ.
4.1.technique: Contradiction assumes a positive limiting gap, so the same BFGS sequence is also a sequence for the smooth replacement.

4.3.condition: An open V⊂U contains closure of the sequence and has inf_V f=min f; for everyδ>0, a C² convex replacement on an open convex neighborhood of the initial sublevel agrees wherever dist(x,Vᶜ)>δ.
4.3.technique: Replacement away from a shrinking nonsmooth neighborhood, followed by approximation of the infimum throughV.

4.2.conclusion: Every BFGS sequence converges to0 in arbitrary finite dimension.
